role: Distinct Working Memory Rscf — Memory system engine within the memory domain.

capabilities.name: distinct_working.manage_memory
capabilities.description: Manage memory: storage, retrieval, decay, and consolidation

capabilities.name: distinct_working.resolve_conflict
capabilities.description: Resolve memory conflicts: contradictions, staleness, and priority

capabilities.name: distinct_working.enforce_firewall
capabilities.description: Enforce memory firewall: prevent unauthorized access and tampering

capabilities.name: distinct_working.track_dynamics
capabilities.description: Track memory dynamics: formation, consolidation, and forgetting curves

capabilities.name: distinct_working.manage_lifecycle
capabilities.description: Manage lifecycle: classify, validate, trace, assess, detect.

capabilities.name: distinct_working.detect_drift
capabilities.description: Detect drift in evidence chains, provenance freshness, or confidence calibration.

capabilities.name: distinct_working.validate_outputs

operations.action: Load the amos-distinct-working-memory-rscf skill and its content
Classify the query against memory sub-capabilities
Apply the appropriate capability with epistemic class labeling
Validate results against domain validation gates
Present results with provenance and confidence ceiling

integrity_requirements: Law of Law: no unresolved contradictions within the skill's scope
Epistemic class: all claims labeled SOURCE / DERIVED / AMOS_MODEL / EMPIRICAL
Provenance: source path recorded for every derived claim
Anti-overreach: no claim beyond the skill's declared scope
Failure mode: on validation failure, downgrade confidence, flag the gap, escalate
safety_constraints: No claim beyond established evidence or explicitly labeled AMOS_MODEL
Fail closed on UNKNOWN/GAP: do not fabricate to remove placeholders
